articles.title: Budget talks resume
articles.text: Finance ministers met in London on 3 March 2024 to discuss the budget. The talks resumed yesterday after a short pause.

articles.title: Summit in Washington
articles.text: President Joe Biden hosted Chancellor Olaf Scholz in Washington on Tuesday. The two leaders spoke about trade and energy.

articles.title: United Nations report
articles.text: The United Nations published a report on food prices on 2024-02-14. Secretary-General António Guterres called the findings worrying.

articles.title: Floods near Jakarta
articles.text: Heavy rain flooded several districts near Jakarta yesterday. Officials said schools would reopen on 12 January 2025.

articles.title: Markets in Tokyo
articles.text: Shares rose in Tokyo on Monday as the yen weakened. The Bank of Japan kept its rate unchanged on 19 March 2024.

articles.title: Election in Mexico
articles.text: Voters in Mexico City went to the polls on 2 June 2024. Claudia Sheinbaum won the presidential election by a wide margin.

articles.title: Health agency warning
articles.text: The World Health Organization warned about measles cases in Nairobi and Lagos. The warning was issued on 2023-11-20.

articles.title: Rail strike in Paris
articles.text: Rail workers in Paris walked out on Thursday. Unions said the strike would end on 15 May 2024.

articles.title: Central bank decision
articles.text: The European Central Bank cut its main rate on 6 June 2024. President Christine Lagarde said further cuts were not decided.

articles.title: Space launch
articles.text: NASA launched a weather satellite from Florida last week. The agency said the first images would arrive tomorrow.

articles.title: Trade fair in Toronto
articles.text: A technology fair opened in Toronto on 9 September 2024. Exhibitors from Sydney and São Paulo attended.

articles.title: Drought in Johannesburg
articles.text: Water restrictions started in Johannesburg on 1 October 2023. The city council said rationing could last until December.

articles.title: Daily Test editorial
articles.text: The Daily Test reports that readers asked for more science coverage. The Daily Test will publish a weekly science page from 4 April 2024.

articles.title: Heat in Delhi
articles.text: Temperatures in Delhi reached 46 degrees on 28 May 2024. Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a meeting on heat relief.

articles.title: Talks in Istanbul
articles.text: Delegations met in Istanbul on 22 July 2023 to discuss grain exports. The agreement was extended until 18 November.

articles.title: Football final
articles.text: Real Madrid won the final in London on 1 June 2024. The club said celebrations would take place in Madrid on Sunday.
